name: Frame Perfect Buffer
description: Holds an early jump input and fires it on the last viable 240Hz tick.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the input buffer.

max-delay.name: Max delay (ticks)
max-delay.description: The most 240Hz ticks a press may be held back. If no better tick is found before this runs out, the press fires anyway. 1 tick = 1/240 s (~4.2 ms). Keep this small: every jump inside this window gets moved to its last viable tick.

hazard-hitbox-scale.name: Hazard hitbox scale
hazard-hitbox-scale.description: Size of the player's inner (hazard) hitbox relative to the full hitbox, used when predicting a death on the next tick. GD uses roughly 0.25-0.33 for the cube.

buffer-ufo-swing.name: Buffer UFO / swing taps
buffer-ufo-swing.description: Also hold back taps in UFO and swing modes (released only by the death-imminent check or the max delay).

player-2.name: Buffer player 2 inputs
player-2.description: Apply the buffer to the second player in dual mode.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: When at least one press in an attempt was actually delayed, do not save progress or completion for that attempt (completion runs as test mode).

show-indicator.name: Show indicator
show-indicator.description: Small label in the corner showing how many presses were corrected this attempt and by how many ticks.
